Self-serve password reset. A \"Forgotten your password?\" link sends a single-use reset link to the user's registered work email address, valid for thirty minutes; the page's response is the same whether or not the address is registered.\n\n7. Session timeout. A signed-in session expires after twenty minutes of inactivity, with a warning shown two minutes before, and the user is returned to the login page with an explanation rather than an error.\n\n8. Access removal.
